vocabulary.meaning_en: sharing ideas and information with others
vocabulary.note_ar: الفعل communicate؛ التواصل الجيد يبدأ بالاستماع والفهم
vocabulary.example: Good communication reduces mistakes.
vocabulary.note_en: The verb is "communicate". Good communication starts with listening and understanding.

vocabulary.meaning_en: people working together for one goal
vocabulary.example: The project succeeded because of great teamwork.
vocabulary.note_en: A compound word: team + work.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the skill of guiding a group of people
vocabulary.note_ar: اللاحقة ship تحوّل leader إلى اسم يدل على صفة أو مهارة (مثل friendship)
vocabulary.example: She showed strong leadership during the crisis.
vocabulary.note_en: The ending -ship turns "leader" into a quality or skill (like "friendship").

vocabulary.meaning_en: the ability to find answers to difficult problems
vocabulary.note_ar: نضع شرطة - بين الكلمتين عندما نستخدمهما ككلمة واحدة
vocabulary.example: This job needs good problem-solving skills.
vocabulary.note_en: We put a hyphen (-) between the two words when we use them as one word.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the ability to make new and unusual ideas
vocabulary.example: Creativity can save a company time and money.
vocabulary.note_en: creative = full of new ideas; create = to make something new.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the skill of planning and arranging things well; also a company or group
vocabulary.note_ar: تُكتب organisation بحرف s في بريطانيا
vocabulary.example: Her organization skills are excellent.
vocabulary.note_en: Spelled "organisation" with an "s" in Britain.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the skill of choosing between options
vocabulary.example: Decision-making is hard when time is short.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to be in charge of people or work
vocabulary.example: He manages a team of ten people.
vocabulary.note_en: manager = the person who manages; management = the act of managing.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to arrange or plan something
vocabulary.example: Who is organizing the meeting?

vocabulary.meaning_en: to help someone
vocabulary.example: Our manager always supports new staff.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to watch work to make sure it is done well and safely
vocabulary.example: She supervises the work on the building site.
vocabulary.note_en: supervisor = the person who supervises.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to make a plan or shape for something new
vocabulary.example: They designed a new app for customers.
vocabulary.note_en: The "g" is silent: /dɪˈzaɪn/

vocabulary.meaning_en: to decide in advance what you will do
vocabulary.example: We planned the project carefully.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to manage or direct how something works
vocabulary.example: The manager controls the budget.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to show or explain something to a group
vocabulary.note_ar: كفعل النبرة على المقطع الثاني: preSENT، وكاسم (هدية) النبرة على الأول: PREsent
vocabulary.example: I will present the results at the meeting.
vocabulary.note_en: As a verb, the stress is on the second syllable: preSENT. As a noun (a gift), the stress is on the first: PREsent.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to guide or be in charge of a group
vocabulary.example: Who will lead the new team?
vocabulary.note_en: Past tense: led.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a single piece of work you have to do
vocabulary.example: My first task today is to answer emails.

vocabulary.meaning_en: something you must do because of your job
vocabulary.example: Checking the stock is one of my duties.
vocabulary.note_en: Plural: duties.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a job or role you must take care of
vocabulary.example: Training new staff is my responsibility.
vocabulary.note_en: responsible for = in charge of and accountable for.

vocabulary.meaning_en: something good you succeed in doing
vocabulary.example: Finishing early was a great achievement.
vocabulary.note_en: From the verb "achieve".

vocabulary.meaning_en: how well someone does their work
vocabulary.example: His performance improved this year.
vocabulary.note_en: From the verb "perform".

vocabulary.meaning_en: moving forward towards a goal
vocabulary.note_ar: كاسم النبرة على الأول PROgress، وكفعل على الثاني proGRESS
vocabulary.example: We are making good progress on the report.
vocabulary.note_en: As a noun, the stress is on the first syllable: PROgress. As a verb, on the second: proGRESS.

vocabulary.meaning_en: doing work well without wasting time, effort or money
vocabulary.example: The new system is more efficient.
vocabulary.note_en: efficiency = the noun.

vocabulary.meaning_en: producing the result you want
vocabulary.example: The advert was very effective; sales doubled.
vocabulary.note_en: effectiveness = the noun.

vocabulary.meaning_en: someone you can trust to do what they promise
vocabulary.example: She is dependable; she never misses a deadline.
vocabulary.note_en: depend on = to trust or need someone.

vocabulary.meaning_en: able to change easily when things change
vocabulary.example: We need flexible staff who can work different shifts.

vocabulary.meaning_en: using new and original ideas
vocabulary.example: The company is famous for its innovative products.
vocabulary.note_en: innovate = to create new ideas; innovation = a new idea or method.

vocabulary.meaning_en: putting a lot of effort into work
vocabulary.example: He is the most hardworking person on the team.

vocabulary.meaning_en: thinking carefully and caring about others
vocabulary.example: It was thoughtful of you to help the new trainee.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to make something smaller or less
vocabulary.example: Clear instructions reduce errors.

vocabulary.meaning_en: doing several jobs at the same time
vocabulary.example: Working in a small shop needs a lot of multitasking.
vocabulary.note_en: multi = many.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a book that tells you how to do or use something
vocabulary.example: Read the training manual before your first day.
vocabulary.note_en: As an adjective, "manual" means done by hand.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the last time or date to finish something
vocabulary.example: The deadline for the report is Friday.

fine_lines.title: efficient vs effective
fine_lines.explanation_ar: efficient يعني أن تعمل الشيء بالطريقة الصحيحة بأقل استهلاك للوقت والجهد والمال، والتركيز هنا على طريقة التنفيذ. effective يعني أن تعمل الشيء الذي يحقق الهدف، والتركيز على النتيجة فقط. مثال: لو قتلت بعوضة بمدفع فالحل effective لأن البعوضة ماتت، لكنه ليس efficient لأنك خرّبت الغرفة.

examples.sentence: An efficient worker finishes fast without wasting materials.
The medicine was effective; my headache stopped.

fine_lines.explanation_en: "Efficient" means doing something in the right way, using the least time, effort and money; the focus is on how you do it. "Effective" means doing what achieves the goal; the focus is only on the result. Example: if you kill a mosquito with a cannon, it is effective because the mosquito is dead, but it is not efficient because you destroyed the room.

fine_lines.title: task vs duty vs responsibility
fine_lines.explanation_ar: task مهمة محددة وسريعة تنجزها وتشطب عليها قبل نهاية اليوم. duty واجب ثابت مرتبط بوظيفتك ومكتوب غالباً في عقدك. responsibility الدور الذي أنت مسؤول عنه وتُحاسَب على نتيجته على المدى الطويل.

examples.sentence: My last task today is to send the invoice.
Answering the phone is one of the receptionist's duties.
The team's safety is the supervisor's responsibility.

fine_lines.explanation_en: A task is a small, specific job you finish and tick off before the end of the day. A duty is a regular part of your job, often written in your contract. A responsibility is a role you are in charge of, and people judge you on its results over a long time.

fine_lines.title: present (noun) vs present (verb)
fine_lines.explanation_ar: نفس الكتابة لكن النبرة تغيّر المعنى. PREsent بنبرة على المقطع الأول اسم = هدية. preSENT بنبرة على المقطع الثاني فعل = يعرض أو يقدّم. وكذلك PROgress اسم و proGRESS فعل.

examples.sentence: She gave me a lovely birthday present.
Tom will present the new plan tomorrow.

fine_lines.explanation_en: Same spelling, but the stress changes the meaning. PREsent (stress on the first syllable) is a noun = a gift. preSENT (stress on the second syllable) is a verb = to show or give a talk. In the same way, PROgress is a noun and proGRESS is a verb.

fine_lines.title: due vs due to
fine_lines.explanation_ar: due وحدها تعني الموعد النهائي للتسليم: The report is due Thursday. أما due to فتعني «بسبب» ويأتي بعدها اسم وليس فعلاً.

examples.sentence: The rent is due on the first of the month.
The flight was late due to bad weather.

fine_lines.explanation_en: "Due" alone means the final date to hand something in: "The report is due Thursday." "Due to" means "because of", and it is followed by a noun, not a verb.

expressions.meaning_ar: يقوم بعدة أدوار ومهام في نفس الوقت
expressions.example: In a small company, I wear many hats: sales, accounts and delivery.
expressions.meaning_en: to do several different jobs or roles at the same time

expressions.meaning_ar: يسير حسب الخطة والجدول بدون تأخير
expressions.example: Don't worry, the project is on track.
expressions.meaning_en: going as planned, with no delay

expressions.example: A good leader takes responsibility for the team's mistakes.
expressions.meaning_en: to accept that something is your duty and its results are your fault or credit

expressions.example: We need to think outside the box to solve this.
expressions.meaning_en: to think in a new, creative way

expressions.meaning_ar: الاستماع الفعّال: التركيز الكامل وفهم الطرف الآخر قبل الرد
expressions.example: Active listening helps you understand your customers.
expressions.meaning_en: listening with full attention and understanding the other person before you reply

expressions.phrase: give someone a piece of your mind
expressions.meaning_ar: يوبّخ شخصاً ويقول له رأيه بغضب
expressions.example: If you're late again, the boss will give you a piece of his mind.
expressions.meaning_en: to tell someone angrily what you think of them

grammar.title: be to + verb: official plans
grammar.explanation_ar: نستخدم be to + الفعل في صورته الأساسية للحديث عن شيء مقرر رسمياً في الجدول (اجتماعات، مواعيد، رحلات). وبمعنى قريب نستخدم be scheduled to.
examples: The meeting is to start at 10 o'clock.
The flight is scheduled to take off at midnight.
The manager is to visit our branch on Monday.
grammar.explanation_en: Use "be to" + base verb to talk about something officially planned on a schedule (meetings, appointments, trips). "Be scheduled to" has a similar meaning.

grammar.title: due (deadline) and due to (because of)
grammar.explanation_ar: due = موعد التسليم النهائي، ويأتي بعده وقت. due to = بسبب، ويأتي بعده اسم وليس فعلاً.
examples: The monthly report is due next Thursday.
The delay was due to poor communication.
The factory closed due to a power cut.
grammar.explanation_en: "Due" = the final date to hand something in, followed by a time. "Due to" = because of, followed by a noun, not a verb.

questions.question: You killed a mosquito with a cannon. The solution was:
questions.explanation_ar: حقق الهدف فهو effective، لكن بهدر كبير فليس efficient.
questions.explanation_en: It achieved the goal, so it was effective, but it wasted a lot, so it was not efficient.

questions.question: The final report is ___ next Thursday.
questions.explanation_en: Due = the final date to hand something in.

questions.question: The project was late ___ poor communication.
"I wear many hats at work" means I:
questions.explanation_ar: wear many hats = يقوم بعدة أدوار في نفس الوقت.
questions.explanation_en: "Wear many hats" = to do several roles at the same time.

questions.question: The meeting ___ start at 9 a.m. (it's on the official schedule)
questions.explanation_ar: be to + الفعل للأمور المقررة رسمياً.
questions.explanation_en: "Be to" + verb is used for things officially planned.

questions.question: "The project is on track" means it is:
questions.explanation_ar: on track = يسير حسب الخطة بدون تأخير.
questions.explanation_en: "On track" = going as planned, with no delay.

questions.question: A person you can always trust to finish the work is:
questions.explanation_en: Dependable = someone you can rely on.

questions.question: In the verb "present" (to show), the stress is on:
questions.explanation_ar: كفعل النبرة على المقطع الثاني preSENT.
questions.explanation_en: As a verb, the stress is on the second syllable: preSENT.

questions.question: A supervisor's job is to:
choices: watch the work to make sure it is done well
questions.explanation_ar: supervise = يشرف على سير العمل وجودته.
questions.explanation_en: To supervise = to watch over the work and check its quality.

questions.question: A small single job you finish today is a:
questions.explanation_en: A task is a small, specific job you can finish quickly.
